features.title: Smart Cut Data Model And API Contract
features.goal: Define task tables, edit version anchors, upload states, and API schemas for smart cut.

API contracts cover create, upload-prepare, upload-complete, analyze, preview, finalize, and task detail

features.title: TOS Upload Prepare And Complete Flow
features.goal: Implement frontend-direct upload preparation and secure upload completion binding.
acceptance: API returns upload parameters for video and reference text
upload-complete validates object key prefix and object existence

features.title: Worker Queue And Task Lifecycle
features.goal: Wire smart_cut_analyze, smart_cut_preview, and smart_cut_finalize into the worker runtime.
acceptance: Each stage is a separate queued task
Worker updates task status and error stage consistently
Local work_dir reuse follows the hard caching rules

features.title: Online Version Analyze Processor
features.goal: Implement analyze processor that downloads TOS inputs and runs the existing flow-a entrypoint with deterministic naming.
acceptance: Processor uses absolute path to run_raw_cut.py
Processor uses task_<task_id> output prefix
Script, ASR, DelayCuts, and analyze artifacts are persisted and queryable
features.owner_notes: Implemented in src/analyze_processor.py. Includes process_analyze() and analyze_pipeline().

features.title: Preview Processor And Delete-Range-Only Contract
features.goal: Implement preview processing and enforce the delete-only editing model.
acceptance: Preview rejects edits that mutate正文字符内容
Edited script only differs in brace-marked delete ranges
Preview persists active_edit_id only for successful preview runs

features.title: Generate Audio B For Preview
features.goal: Produce audio_b for试听 using robust ffmpeg processing and upload it to TOS.
acceptance: audio_b is generated without -c copy concat strategy
audio_b uploads to TOS and returns a stable URL
audio_b failure is surfaced as preview failure
features.owner_notes: Implemented in src/generate_audio_b.py. Uses FFmpeg filter_complex for single-pass encoding.

features.title: Pause Mapping To DirectCutter-Compatible JSON
features.goal: Map pause cuts from audio_a timeline back to original timeline and dump compatible JSON.
acceptance: Mapped pause cuts are stored in DirectCutter-compatible cut_segments format
Time unit is milliseconds in the dumped JSON
Finalize can consume the file without custom adapter logic
features.owner_notes: Implemented in src/pause_mapping.py. Includes map_pauses_to_original_seconds() and dump_pause_cuts_for_direct_cutter().

features.title: Online Final Video Cutter With Dynamic Bitrate
features.goal: Implement online final cutter that preserves cut logic but controls output bitrate parameters.
acceptance: Output bitrate follows min(input_bitrate, 12Mbps) with 12Mbps fallback
Cut plan is saved alongside final video
Implementation does not rely on original DirectCutter.cut fixed encoding params
features.owner_notes: Implemented in src/final_video_cutter.py. OnlineFinalVideoCutter class with configurable bitrate.

features.title: Finalize Processor With Normalize-On-Finalize
features.goal: Implement finalize stage using output_mode and last successful preview outputs.
acceptance: original mode uses original local video copy
vertical_1080p mode generates normalized_input.mp4 and normalized_input.process.json
Finalize records final_video_url and final_upload_status
features.owner_notes: Implemented in src/finalize_processor.py. Includes process_finalize() and finalize_pipeline().

features.title: GroundTruth Recorder And TOS Directory Upload
features.goal: Record opted-in GroundTruth samples into the required TOS directory structure.
acceptance: feed_to_ai defaults to true and is accepted by finalize API
GroundTruth directory contains reference.txt, analyze_script.txt, edited_script.txt, asr_result.json, metadata.json
